import urllib.request
import json

# Query NCBI Gene 8790
url = "https://api.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/v2alpha/gene/id/8790"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        gene_info = data.get('genes', [{}])[0].get('gene', {})
        print("NCBI Symbol:", gene_info.get('symbol'))
        print("NCBI Description:", gene_info.get('description'))
        print("NCBI Synonyms:", gene_info.get('synonyms'))
except Exception as e:
    print("NCBI error:", e)

# Also check UniProt text format for gene name
url_txt = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O14772.txt"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url_txt) as resp:
    lines = resp.read().decode().splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("GN   "):
            print(line)
